Pinterest's MCP servers are internal engineering tools; registry entries are community (github.com/getmcpads-com/pinterest-ads-mcp-server, not official). Discovery 2026-10-08: no MCP or OAuth metadata found.

name: Snapchat
alternative: The person's Snapchat data download (My Data, requested from accounts.snapchat.com), which includes saved chat history, snap history, Memories, friends and purchase history
notes: Snap Kit Login Kit (OAuth 2.0) returns only identity data such as display name and Bitmoji, Creative Kit only shares into Snapchat, and every Snap Kit app needs Snap's review before production; there is no API for snaps, chats, stories or friends. My Data is a one-off file, not a live connection. Community servers cover only Snap's Ads API, such as github.com/cesteral/mcp-open-advertising (registry io.github.cesteral/snapchat-mcp) and Pipeboard's hosted Snap Ads server (third party). Discovery 2026-10-09: no MCP or OAuth metadata found; accounts.snapchat.com publishes no OpenID configuration.

name: Threads
alternative: The person creates their own Meta app and adds their Threads profile as a Threads Tester (no App Review needed for testers); or the person's Threads data download
notes: The Threads API needs a Meta app whose permissions pass Meta App Review before people without a role on the app can grant them, and Meta requires business verification for advanced access to any permission, so D as for Instagram and Facebook. Meta also runs an undocumented MCP at mcp.threads.com/threads; registry entries are third-party (e.g. threads-mcp.app). Discovery 2026-10-09: the endpoint returns 401 naming resource_metadata at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/threads and Threads scopes (threads_basic, threads_content_publish and more), but that metadata URL returns 404 and no authorization-server metadata was found, so DCR and CIMD are unknown.

name: Microsoft Copilot
alternative: the CSV of the person's Copilot app activity history exported from the Microsoft privacy dashboard (Export all activity history)
notes: The consumer Copilot app has no public API or MCP; Microsoft's Copilot APIs and the registry's Work IQ Copilot server (com.microsoft/workiq-m365copilot) are tenant-scoped Microsoft 365 products that need a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence. For personal Microsoft accounts, Microsoft documents a CSV export of Copilot activity history from the privacy dashboard.

name: Perplexity
alternative: Local server @perplexity-ai/mcp-server with the person's own API key
notes: Official remote MCP (search, ask, research, reason) accepts Sign in with Perplexity or an API key as bearer token; tool calls are billed at metered API pricing to the person's key or organization (no free tier documented). Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD yes, S256, token auth none or client secret; registry server ai.perplexity/mcp-server is vendor-published.

name: Apple Find My
alternative: The person's Apple Account data copy from privacy.apple.com (one-off snapshot, availability varies by country or region): Devices.csv, People.csv and Location Information.csv read on the Mac; current positions are not readable because Apple stores them encrypted
notes: Apple's Data & Privacy file guides document Find My data in the account data copy: Devices.csv (devices and accessories, Find My and lost-mode status), People.csv (location-sharing followers and following, notification fences with addresses) and Location Information.csv. Device and friend locations appear only in encrypted form, so the copy gives no usable current or past locations. There is no web API, the Mac Find My app has no AppleScript dictionary or Shortcuts actions, and the Find My network programme is for accessory makers.

name: Life360
alternative: The person's personal-information request in the Life360 app (Settings > Privacy Center > Your Privacy Choices > Your Data Rights > Request my personal information) or by email to privacy@life360.com, read locally
notes: Life360 lets a member request their personal information, including in a portable format, from the app's Privacy Center or by emailing privacy@life360.com; it is a one-off copy, not live location or place alerts. Its privacy policy frames the right under GDPR and US state privacy laws, so availability elsewhere is not guaranteed. No public Life360 API or official MCP; community server github.com/rjlee/life360-mcp uses undocumented endpoints, not official.

name: Ring
alternative: Ring API in developer test mode on the person's own Ring account and devices (needs Ring developer registration and ID verification), or the person's Home Assistant Ring integration (community-maintained, unofficial API)
notes: Ring APIs (live video, motion and doorbell events, device status, event history) are open to registered Ring developers (business details and government-ID verification), and only apps that pass certification, including security and privacy review, can be published to the Ring Appstore for customers to link; the model is cloud-to-cloud with the developer's own OAuth and webhook endpoints. The Ring Appstore Knowledge MCP (knowledge.appstore-mcp.ring.amazon.dev) only searches documentation. Discovery 2026-10-09: no account MCP or OAuth metadata found; the docs MCP returned 405 to GET.

name: Philips Hue
alternative: Local Hue Bridge CLIP API with an application key the person creates by pressing the bridge link button (LAN only, no review)
notes: Signify runs a remote MCP on its meethue.com domain with open dynamic client registration, but no Hue developer or support page documents it yet, so tools and stability are unconfirmed; the documented routes are the local Bridge API and the Remote Hue API (free developer account). Community servers exist (e.g. github.com/m2ai-mcp-servers/mcp-philips-hue). Discovery 2026-10-09: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256, token endpoint auth none.

name: SmartThings
alternative: a SmartThings personal access token the person creates (valid only 24 hours), or SmartThings devices shared to Apple Home and reached through Home actions in Shortcuts
notes: No official MCP and nothing in the MCP Registry (community servers are listed on Glama; not reviewed here). SmartThings' public API uses OAuth with a client secret and public HTTPS redirect URIs, and its docs say API Access App registration is "coming soon and is not yet available", while personal access tokens now last 24 hours.

name: The Weather Channel
alternative: A free open weather source such as the US National Weather Service API (no key, User-Agent only)
notes: The Weather Company's Data APIs have a 30-day free trial, then self-serve production plans from $500 a month (Standard Annual, 1M calls a month) or Enterprise through sales; the API holds no personal account data. No MCP in its docs; registry 2026-10-08: no Weather Company server.

name: AccuWeather
alternative: Apple Weather on the Mac or iPhone, or the AccuWeather MCP during its 14-day free trial
notes: AccuWeather's MCP takes the person's own API key but works only on the 14-day free trial or the Elite plan ($500/month); after the trial the cheapest route is the REST API on the Starter plan ($2/month, current conditions and 5-day forecasts). The Claude connector at mcp.accuweather.com is a Claude-specific endpoint carrying AccuWeather's own key, not for other clients. Discovery 2026-10-08: no OAuth metadata (API key only).

name: Ticketmaster
alternative: Ticketmaster's partner MCP if Ticketmaster admits Kipster as a client (class C); order confirmation emails in the person's mailbox for their own tickets
notes: Ticketmaster's own MCP (no sign-in, event search and ticket links only) is offered as a connector inside ChatGPT and Claude and returned 403 to direct requests, so the workable route is the Discovery API with a free self-serve key (5,000 calls a day, 5 per second) that covers the public event catalogue, not the person's orders. Discovery 2026-10-08: MCP endpoint and well-known paths returned 403, no metadata; registry entries are community (github.com/pipeworx-io/mcp-ticketmaster).

name: Eventbrite
alternative: Order confirmation emails in the person's mailbox (IMAP) for their own ticket orders; or the person requests their own API key (approved by Eventbrite) and pastes its private token
notes: Eventbrite API v3 covers the person's orders (users/me/orders) and organizer events, but API keys (which carry the private token and the OAuth client) are requested in Account Settings and Eventbrite emails when the key is approved (help article updated 2026-09-21); default limits are 2,000 calls an hour and 48,000 a day per application. Public event search was shut down in 2019. No vendor MCP (mcp.eventbrite.com redirects to an organizer page); registry has community github.com/chrischall/eventbrite-mcp and the hosted third-party io.usefulapi/eventbrite. Discovery 2026-10-09: no MCP or OAuth metadata found.

name: Steam
alternative: none
notes: The Steam Web API takes a free user key that anyone with a Steam account creates on the Steam Community registration page after agreeing to the Web API terms; it reads profiles, owned games, achievements and news, subject to the person's profile privacy. No vendor MCP; registry servers are community (e.g. github.com/Grinv/steam-games-mcp). Discovery 2026-10-09: no MCP or OAuth metadata found (api.steampowered.com/mcp 404; store well-known paths redirect to the homepage).

name: PlayStation
alternative: PlayStation Store receipt emails in the person's mailbox, or a copy of their data through Sony's privacy right-of-access request
notes: No official MCP and no public PSN API; Sony's developer access is the partner-only PlayStation Partners programme. notes: Xbox documents a Captures app backup that bulk-uploads existing clips and screenshots to OneDrive and can upload future captures automatically; this covers captures only, not achievements or play history, which Microsoft's privacy FAQ says are viewed at My Xbox with no export. notes: ESPN is covered by The Walt Disney Company privacy policy, whose US state privacy rights page documents a request to access personal information in a portable format through usprivacy.disney.com; this is a one-off snapshot for residents of certain US states, not a live link to favourites or fantasy leagues. notes: Zillow's MCP backs its app in ChatGPT and is not documented for other clients; its resource metadata names a ChatGPT Zillow gateway and an Amazon Cognito authorization server with no registration endpoint and client-secret methods only, so Kipster would need Zillow to issue it a client. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR no, CIMD no, S256; registry entries are community or scrapers (github.com/chrischall/zillow-mcp).

notes: Fleet API needs an application with legal business details, a public key hosted on the app's domain, and pay-per-use billing with a payment method on file (a $10 monthly discount for individual developers); vehicle commands also need a virtual key added to the car. Discovery 2026-10-09: auth.tesla.com and fleet-auth third-party OpenID metadata, DCR no, CIMD no, no code_challenge_methods advertised, client_secret_post only.

name: Verizon

notes: No public API for Verizon consumer accounts; Verizon's developer platform ThingSpace serves business IoT connectivity, not a person's line or bill. Discovery 2026-10-09: no MCP or OAuth metadata found (www.verizon.com/mcp redirects to the homepage, no mcp.verizon.com host).

notes: No MCP (none official or in the registry) and no API for a person's own account, bills or usage; AT&T's developer offerings (API Marketplace messaging and voice, enterprise and invite-only network APIs) are for businesses building products. myAT&T lets the person download PDF bills, which Kipster can read locally.

notes: No public API for a customer's own account (bills, usage, plan); T-Mobile's developer work (DevEdge) targets IoT and business developers. notes: Tinder (Match Group) has no public API or MCP, and its terms forbid using any robot, crawler or other automatic process to access or retrieve data from the service, so only the person's own exported data is usable. notes: Chewy publishes no customer API or MCP for orders, Autoship or pet profiles; its privacy policy offers access and portability requests. notes: OpenTable's APIs (Online Booking or Consumer API, Directory, Reviews) are for partners under a business-development contract, using client-credentials tokens, so they are not a route into a diner's own account; contract pricing is not published. notes: No public consumer API: developer.starbucks.com redirects to Starbucks' internal sign-in, and Rewards and ordering have no documented third-party access. No MCP in the registry or on vendor sites (Discovery 2026-10-08: no MCP or OAuth metadata found).

name: Grubhub

notes: Grubhub's developer portal serves restaurant and integration partners (menus, order intake), not diners' accounts, and no official MCP was found. Community server: github.com/markswendsen-code/mcp-grubhub, not official. notes: Hulu (Disney) has no public or partner API for subscriber accounts (watchlist, viewing history) and no vendor MCP; www.hulu.com now redirects to disneyplus.com. notes: No MCP (none official or in the registry) and no public developer API for HBO Max accounts, watch history or the catalogue; its documented Siri support covers search and playback (e.g. on Vision Pro), with no documented Shortcuts actions. notes: No YouTube Music API; the YouTube Data API v3 reaches the account's playlists, ratings and subscriptions (free 10,000 units a day) but its youtube scopes need Google sensitive-scope verification. notes: Pandora's privacy policy (Sirius XM) lets residents of certain US states request a copy of their personal data in a readily usable format, through an online form for Pandora listeners or privacy@pandora.com; this is a one-off snapshot, not live access to stations or thumbs. notes: Amazon says the Amazon Music Web API (Login with Amazon OAuth plus a security profile ID as x-api-key; library, playlists, podcasts) is in closed beta for already approved developers and the security profile must be enabled by Amazon Music. notes: Microsoft Graph has no PowerPoint content API, so decks are read and written as .pptx files in OneDrive (delegated Files.Read or Files.ReadWrite, personal accounts supported, PDF conversion available) through one free Entra app registration set to personal accounts; Microsoft's Work IQ MCP servers are business-tenant only, need a Microsoft 365 Copilot license and have no PowerPoint server. notes: The Slides API presentations and presentations.readonly scopes are sensitive, so a public app needs Google app verification; Google's remote Slides MCP (Workspace Developer Preview, read_presentation and update_presentation, pre-registered Google Cloud OAuth client) also lists the restricted drive and drive.readonly scopes, which would make the MCP route class D. notes: Canva hosts the MCP server, but a CIMD client's redirect URI must be added to Canva's MCP allowlist through a reviewed waitlist (DCR is deprecated there), and Developer Portal public apps are reviewed before release; most tools work on free plans, with resize, autofill and brand kits on Pro. alternative: order emails in the person's mailbox

notes: Claude's directory lists this hotel-search MCP as made by Tripadvisor with no sign-in (search_hotels, hotel_details, compare_hotels); it covers public hotel data, not the person's trips, saves or reviews, and the URL is not published in Tripadvisor's own docs. notes: Samsung offers only the on-device Android Samsung Health Data SDK, which works for distributed apps only after a partnership request and approval; there is no web API a Mac app can call. notes: Citi's developer and partner portals serve commercial partners (co-brand card partners and institutional clients), not a self-serve API on a person's own accounts; no vendor MCP. notes: No official Twitch MCP; registry entries are third-party (e.g. github.com/pipeworx-io/mcp-twitch, a hosted gateway that would route data through its cloud). notes: Arlo publishes no developer API; it integrates only through Alexa, Google Assistant, Apple HomeKit, SmartThings and IFTTT (developer.arlo.co is a different company). Registry 2026-10-08: no official server.

notes: Deliveroo's developer portal offers only partner APIs for restaurants, grocery retailers and its Signature delivery service (orders, menus, sites), not customers' accounts, and no MCP was found. Discovery 2026-10-08: mcp.deliveroo.com does not resolve; registry: no server.

alternative: Numbers' AppleScript dictionary on the Mac, or spreadsheets the person exports to CSV or Excel

notes: Grab's developer portal covers partner and merchant APIs only (GrabFood, GrabMart, GrabExpress, GrabPay, Login with Grab, Farefeed, Grab for Business), with no API for a rider's own trips or orders. mcp.grab.com resolves but returns 403 and no Grab documentation names an MCP; the community registry server io.github.SeaMCP/grabfood (github.com/SeaMCP/grabfood-mcp) searches public GrabFood menus through SEA MCP's hosted service (third party, Google sign-in), not a rider's account. notes: Fi smart dog collar (tryfi.com now redirects to fitracking.com) has no public API or MCP, and its help centre documents no Apple Health, Shortcuts or self-service export. Flag: requests go to Etherscan or an RPC provider, a third party, and reveal the address; community server github.com/Xiawpohr/metamask-mcp is not official.

name: PayByPhone
alternative: parking receipt emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No public consumer API; PayByPhone offers business and fleet accounts through a separate business portal, not a personal-account API. No MCP in the registry.

name: Wingstop
alternative: Order receipt emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No public ordering or account API found. Community server: github.com/markswendsen-code/mcp-wingstop, not official (drives the website with Playwright).

name: Genius Scan
alternative: scans the person exports as PDFs to a Files, iCloud Drive or cloud-storage folder that Kipster reads on the Mac
notes: Genius Scan has no account API or MCP; its help centre documents export destinations and Shortcuts, so exported files are the route. No MCP Registry entry.

name: Tresorit
alternative: Files in the person's Tresorit sync folders or Tresorit Drive on the Mac, read as local files
notes: Tresorit is end-to-end encrypted and publishes no public file API or MCP; Tresorit Drive exposes cloud files in the Mac and Windows file browser, which a local plugin can read.

name: Remini
alternative: the person's data copy from Remini's data request form (a portable electronic list) and downloaded results saved to the Photos library, reachable on the Mac through PhotoKit
notes: Remini (Bending Spoons) publishes no developer API or MCP; remini.ai redirects to the consumer web app. Its help centre documents a data request that returns a portable electronic list of personal data (not uploaded images) and says downloaded results go to the device gallery; the data copy's format is unconfirmed.

name: PhonePe
alternative: Transaction statements PhonePe emails to the person's verified address on request from History in the app, read from the person's mailbox (IMAP)
notes: PhonePe help documents requesting a payment statement for chosen months or a financial year from History in the app; it arrives at the person's registered email, so the kip reads it from the mailbox, refreshed only when the person requests one. PhonePe's developer APIs serve merchants, with no API for a consumer's own account. Registry 2026-10-08: no official server.

name: Riot Games
alternative: none
notes: Riot's developer portal issues personal API keys after registration without approval (production keys need Developer Relations review); game and match data is read by Riot ID, and Riot Sign On access was not confirmed. The registry lists only github.com/pipeworx-io/mcp-riot-games, a third-party gateway that routes data through its host; excluded.

name: McAfee
alternative: Malwarebytes scam-check connector or forwarding suspicious messages to the person's own McAfee app
notes: McAfee's scam-check MCP (email, text and URL checks, no sign-in) is listed as a Claude connector on a Claude-specific gateway that returned 403 to a plain GET, so another client would need McAfee to admit it. It checks content, not the person's McAfee account.

name: Edits
alternative: finished videos the person exports from Edits (up to 4K) to the Photos library, read through PhotoKit on the iPhone or Photos on the Mac; drafts stay in the app
notes: Edits is Instagram's (Meta) on-device video editor with no public API or MCP, and Instagram's Graph API does not cover Edits projects. Its App Store listing documents exporting videos in 4K with no watermark and sharing them, a partial route that covers finished videos only, not drafts, ideas or insights (the listing does not name the Photos library as the destination).

name: One Medical
alternative: Health records the person downloads from the One Medical app or portal, and appointment emails in the person's mailbox
notes: Amazon One Medical offers no public API or MCP for members; the app syncs some data with Apple Health, which is not a route for Kipster.

name: Kiwi.com
alternative: none
notes: Kiwi.com runs an official remote MCP server with one tool, search-flight, and no sign-in (no OAuth discovery metadata; the endpoint answers without auth). Booking is completed on kiwi.com through returned links; the person's own bookings are not exposed.

name: Manus
alternative: Manus API with a self-serve API key
notes: Manus hosts an OAuth MCP (server name manus-chatgpt-app, sign-in on manus.im) built for its ChatGPT app and not in its public docs, so use by other clients is unconfirmed; tasks spend the person's Manus credits. The documented API with self-serve keys is the fallback. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256 yes.

name: NatWest
alternative: statement export (CSV/OFX) from online banking
notes: Account data is reachable only through UK Open Banking, which requires FCA authorisation as an account information provider; no consumer API or MCP. Aggregators exist but route data through a third party; excluded.

name: Lumosity
alternative: A copy of the person's data through Lumosity's privacy request (help centre webform for California residents; dpo@lumoslabs.com for EU and UK GDPR requests)
notes: Lumosity has no public API, MCP or self-service export of training data. Its privacy policy lets California residents request access to and a copy of their information through the help centre or a webform, and names a Data Protection Officer at dpo@lumoslabs.com with EU and UK representatives. Subscription receipts are not a route, and whether the copy includes game scores is not documented.

name: Zappos
alternative: order and shipping confirmation emails in the person's mailbox
notes: Zappos has no consumer API or MCP; its old developer site (developer.zappos.com) now redirects to the store. No MCP Registry entry.

name: The New Yorker
alternative: Public New Yorker RSS feeds (e.g. newyorker.com/feed/everything) and newsletter emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No public API or MCP for a subscriber's account, saved stories or archive; Condé Nast publishes open RSS feeds of new articles.

name: PC Express
alternative: PC Express order confirmation and receipt emails in the person's mailbox
notes: Loblaw publishes no public PC Express API or MCP; community repos such as FireBall1725/pcexpress-mcp-server rely on an OAuth secret reverse-engineered from Loblaw's Android app, which Kipster must not use. name: Paperless Post
alternative: Guest list and RSVP export (CSV) from the event's Tracking page, plus invitation emails in the person's mailbox (IMAP)
notes: No public API or developer programme mentioned (no vendor page states it). Paperless Post documents a CSV export of guests with RSVP status but does not email each RSVP; registry 2026-10-08: no official server.

name: FOX One
alternative: Access and portability request through Fox's privacy portal (privacy.fox.com/main/web/consumer) or 888-596-3929 for the person's personal data in a portable form; residents of Colorado, Connecticut, Virginia and other listed US states with privacy laws, plus California's right to know
notes: No public API for FOX One accounts or watch history and no MCP; foxone.com redirects to fox.com, and the app documents no export or Shortcuts actions. The Fox privacy policy shown on the FOX One site lets residents of listed US states request the personal data Fox holds about them, including in a portable form, which can include viewing activity. name: tado
alternative: HomeKit (V3/V3+) or Matter (tado X) through Apple Home on the Mac
notes: tado's REST API is open but never officially supported for third parties; sign-in uses the OAuth device code flow with tado's own client and is capped at 100 requests a day (20,000 with Auto-Assist or AI Assist). No MCP found in registry or GitHub search.

name: Underdog
alternative: the person's data in a portable format through Underdog's Privacy Request Center (up to twice a year, offered to all US customers)
notes: Underdog publishes no API or MCP for picks, entries or balances, and no data export, Shortcuts actions or entry emails could be confirmed (underdogfantasy.com and its help centre refuse automated fetches). Its privacy policy gives every customer the rights to access and, up to twice a year, a portable copy of their personal data through its Privacy Request Center; whether picks and entries are included is not stated.

name: Going
alternative: A copy of the person's Going account data requested from support@going.com or Going's data subject access request (certain US states, UK and EU rights), read from the copy they receive
notes: Going (formerly Scott's Cheap Flights) has no public API or MCP. Its privacy policy lists access and copy rights for residents of several US states and a right to copies of personal information, requested by email to support@going.com or through a data subject access request. Flight-deal alert emails are the service's content filtered by home airport, not the person's account data, and are not the route.

name: Hims & Hers

notes: Hims & Hers is a telehealth subscription service with no public developer API or MCP; its help pages say it emails a tracking link when each order ships, so a kip can follow orders and refills from the mailbox. Prescriptions and visit records stay in its own apps.

name: Panera Bread
alternative: Order confirmation emails in the person's mailbox (IMAP)
notes: No public ordering or MyPanera API (no vendor page states it); Panera sends order confirmation emails for online orders. Community server: github.com/markswendsen-code/mcp-panera (in the registry), not official.

name: Upside
alternative: cash-back and receipt emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No consumer API; Upside's partnerships (co-marketing, tech integration, affiliate) are for businesses. No MCP in the registry.

notes: No MCP and no API for a subscriber's own account (plan, data usage, bills); Jio's developer platform only covers apps for the Jio set-top box. Jio's FAQ says every postpaid user receives an e-bill PDF at their registered email; prepaid recharge emails are unconfirmed.

notes: No public API for BBC Sounds listening history or subscriptions and no BBC MCP in the registry. The BBC account data request is a one-off copy of most account information and activity, not a live feed; the documented Shortcuts only start playback of a station.

alternative: Daily report and message notification emails in the parent's mailbox
notes: No public developer API or MCP found; parents get access only when their childcare provider invites them. GitHub mcp-subsidy-brightwheel is a provider-side demo, not a server for parent data.

name: DICK'S Sporting Goods
alternative: order and ScoreCard rewards emails in the person's mailbox
notes: DICK'S publishes no consumer API or MCP for orders or ScoreCard rewards. dickssportinggoods.com refused automated fetches, so this rests on the app listing.

notes: Cleo has no public API or MCP; it reads bank data through an aggregator, which routes data through a third party and is excluded. name: Cambly
alternative: Cambly reservation confirmation and lesson reminder emails in the person's mailbox, added to their calendar through the calendar plugin
notes: Cambly publishes no developer API or MCP (no developer or API pages on its site). Its help centre says students get emails to confirm reserved lessons and several reminders before each reservation, which a kip can read from the mailbox; recordings and tutor chats stay in Cambly's own apps.

name: Simplify
alternative: The person's Job Tracker CSV export from Simplify
notes: Simplify documents Export CSV in the Job Tracker, which downloads the tracked application data; any plan requirement is not stated. No public API for a person's applications; the browser extension is Simplify Copilot. Registry 2026-10-08: no official server.

name: Santander

notes: Personal account data is reachable only through regulated open banking (PSD2/UK Open Banking), which needs authorisation as an account information provider; no consumer API or official MCP. notes: AnkiWeb has no public API; local access goes through desktop Anki with a third-party add-on. Community server: github.com/ankimcp/anki-mcp-server, not official.

notes: HMRC's Developer Hub APIs (e.g. Making Tax Digital) sign in the taxpayer with OAuth, but production credentials need an application that HMRC checks, taking up to 10 working days. No HMRC MCP found.

notes: Spike is a client over the person's existing email accounts and has no public API or MCP for its own chat or notes. The iGPT email API promoted on spikenow.com is a separate service that would route mail through a third party.

notes: Official Viator connector (Made by Viator, sign-in not required) with search_experiences and get_experience_details; catalog search only, no access to the person's bookings. notes: Malwarebytes publishes a no-sign-in scam-check MCP (link, phone, email, WHOIS reputation) as a Claude connector on a Claude-specific path; it answered a GET with 405 (POST only) but use by other clients is not documented. It does not reach the person's Malwarebytes account.

name: Netatmo
alternative: none

notes: BetMGM publishes no API or MCP for bets, balances or rewards. name: Ro

notes: Ro is a US telehealth company with no public developer API or MCP found; treatment plans, prescriptions and messages with providers stay in Ro's own app. Ro emails patients about shipments and refills, but ro.co blocked automated fetching, so email contents and the absence of an API are unconfirmed from Ro itself.

name: BBC iPlayer
alternative: The person's BBC account data copy, requested from BBC account settings
notes: BBC says account holders can request a copy of most information and activity on their BBC account from account settings; file format and whether it lists iPlayer viewing are unconfirmed. No public API for a viewer's iPlayer account. Registry 2026-10-08: no official server.

name: REI
alternative: order and shipping emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No public consumer API for REI accounts or orders and no MCP in the registry. REI's shipping help says order updates are sent by email, including a shipping confirmation email when a package leaves its facilities.

notes: No public consumer API; CREA's DDF listing feed is for REALTOR members only, and community server github.com/sanchorelaxo/realtor-mcp (internal site search) is not official. alternative: the person uses Kagi search in the browser
notes: Kagi's official MCP (hosted at mcp.kagi.com, or local uvx kagimcp) takes a Kagi API key as a bearer token, with OAuth on the roadmap; the API is pay-per-use against a prepaid balance.

name: Sweetgreen
alternative: Order and receipt emails in the person's mailbox (IMAP)
notes: sweetgreen offers no public ordering or rewards API and no MCP.

name: CNBC
alternative: CNBC's own public RSS feeds (headlines and links, e.g. Top News)
notes: CNBC publishes no developer API or MCP for readers, and CNBC PRO or watchlist data is reachable only in its own apps. CNBC's own RSS feeds give headlines and links without sign-in, but not the person's watchlists.

alternative: Order emails in the person's mailbox
notes: bigbasket hosts an OAuth MCP (scopes read, write, cart, products), likely behind its ChatGPT shopping pilot; it is not publicly documented, so tool coverage and acceptance of clients other than ChatGPT are unconfirmed. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256 yes. Registry 2026-10-08: no entry.

name: Shell

notes: mcp.shell.com exists but redirects to Shell's corporate Microsoft Entra sign-in, so it is an internal service, not a consumer MCP; no public consumer API for the Shell app or rewards found.

name: Starling Bank
alternative: none

name: How We Feel

notes: TED offers no public developer API or MCP server, and its usage policy forbids scraping video from TED.com. Talk audio and metadata are available through the public TED Talks Daily podcast feed.

notes: Private, application-only dating and networking app with no public API; its privacy policy offers a copy of personal information only by emailing contact@rayatheapp.com, with no stated file or download delivery, and the App Store listing names no Shortcuts actions. name: PurpleAir
alternative: none

notes: GetYourGuide's MCP Apps server (search_activities, no sign-in) is behind an IP allow-list; hosts must submit their egress IPs through the partner contact form. Community server: github.com/chrischall/getyourguide-mcp, not official.

name: Phantom
alternative: none

name: MapQuest

notes: MapQuest's remote MCP (geocoding, routing, place search, traffic, static maps) needs a free MapQuest Developer account and key, then OAuth from the agent; it covers location services, not saved places in the consumer app. Discovery 2026-10-09: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: UnitedHealthcare
alternative: claims and explanation-of-benefits documents the person downloads from myuhc.com
notes: No MCP server; the CMS-mandated Patient Access API (FHIR, OAuth with PKCE) lets members share claims data with an app the developer registers in the Optum vendor portal, with organization attestation and a security and compliance review before production. UHC's own interoperability pages block automated fetching.

name: Session
alternative: The person shares messages with Kipster through the iOS share sheet
notes: Open-source, end-to-end encrypted messenger with no official API, bot interface or CLI; Session's help centre states message backups are not available, and the FAQ says restores recover only the last 14 days. Registry 2026-10-08: no official server; no export, Shortcuts or data-bearing emails found in vendor help, 2026-10-09.

name: Ko-fi

notes: Ko-fi offers only outgoing payment webhooks (donations, subscriptions, shop orders, commissions) to a URL the creator sets, not a readable account API. No MCP in the registry.

alternative: Order and shipping emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No public consumer API or MCP found for Fanatics shopping accounts (registry and GitHub search empty); orders are best read from emails.

notes: Airtel publishes no consumer API or MCP for a subscriber's plan, usage or bills.

The URL recorded is Hubitat's documentation for the built-in connector, which ships in the hub firmware.

No public developer API, Shortcuts or MCP; Sessions metrics sync to partner apps such as Strava (a third party, flagged).

name: Untappd
alternative: the person's check-in export (Untappd Insider)
notes: API v4 uses OAuth with a registered client ID and secret, 100 calls per hour; new app access is reported closed or approval-only, unconfirmed. Community MCPs github.com/darrenjrobinson/untappd-mcp-server and chrischall/untappd-mcp.

name: Congress.gov
alternative: none
notes: Free public Congress.gov API with a self-serve api.data.gov key; public legislative data only, no personal account data. No vendor MCP; community server: github.com/cyanheads/congressgov-mcp-server, not official.

name: HDFC Bank
alternative: account statements downloaded from HDFC NetBanking, or transaction alert emails in the person's mailbox
notes: HDFC Bank's API portal serves business partners, not a person's own accounts; no MCP. Account Aggregator apps and other aggregators route data through a third party and are excluded.

notes: Forest (Seekrtech) has no public API or MCP. Health holds only session times, not tree, tag or friend details.

notes: No official MCP server and no public web API for learner progress (staff have only ever described one as planned). freeCodeCamp settings offer a Download your data button that saves the signed-in account record as JSON; its exact contents are unconfirmed.

alternative: Match alert and account notice emails in the person's mailbox (IMAP)
notes: Shaadi.com publishes no developer API or MCP (no vendor page states it). Its privacy notice lists match alerts and account notices as service communications, but email contents are unconfirmed.

alternative: none

alternative: the person's raw data download from their 23andMe account
notes: Website corrected: www.23andme.com now redirects to www.23andme.org, run by the nonprofit 23andMe Research Institute. name: FreeTaxUSA
alternative: the filed return PDF the person downloads from their FreeTaxUSA account
notes: FreeTaxUSA has no public API or MCP; its website blocked automated fetches. Community github.com/schwarztim/freetaxusa-mcp (listed on Glama) is unofficial.

alternative: none

Its privacy notice takes access requests at transportation-privacy@amazon.com where law requires, and Amazon's state privacy disclosures document a portable-format copy through Request Your Personal Information: a one-off snapshot, limited to applicable US states, and whether it includes Flex earnings is unconfirmed.

name: RentCafe

name: Spotify for Creators
alternative: The show's public RSS feed (read-only)

notes: No public web API for a person's results; Ookla's official CLI runs tests locally and outputs JSON, JSONL or CSV.

notes: No public API or developer programme found; Cloaked's help centre covers only its apps and browser extensions. The registry's 'cloaked' entry is an unrelated Solana project.

alternative: a copy of the person's data, including a machine-readable copy of what they provided, on request to News UK (dataprotection@news.co.uk or its contact form)

alternative: The person's Flipp account information on an access request emailed to privacy@flipp.com
notes: Flipp offers no public consumer API, MCP or shopping-list export; its data products serve retailers and publishers. alternative: booking confirmation emails and e-tickets BookMyShow sends to the person's mailbox

alternative: none

alternative: none

alternative: personal access token, or the gh CLI

name: Adobe Photoshop
alternative: Photoshop scripting on the Mac (UXP scripts or AppleScript) run against the person's installed Photoshop

alternative: none
